policy.scope: Every coverage-union key; all source observations at those keys, including below20 reads
policy.outside_union: All metadata rows counted; cross-run contexts outside the scoreable coverage union are not compared
policy.encoding: ASCII uppercase; U becomes T; recognised ambiguous IUPAC letters map to N (model unknown code4)
policy.primary_rule: One identical unambiguous central-A model-encoded7mer among all source observations at the key
policy.scored_rule: Same rule restricted to observations with source reads>=20
policy.training_support: Descriptive only; weak=True if ANY observed known context has<20 data0 positives. False is not assurance for unknown/ambiguous contexts; see training_support_known_for_all_contexts. No support filter
policy.identifiers: Literal positions; only exact per-run aliases from the supplied table; no generic stripping or offset

interpretation: Context compatibility is not exact FASTA/offset identity, assay validation, independent lab replication or a causal biological effect
resource_scope: Current process from after new output directory creation to summary construction; excludes later input rehashes and final receipt/status writes. No child process or peak-memory claim
